latest.author: bystritskiy
latest.text: Underground 2: saves use the original Xbox layout and format, but they’re signed with a different key than a real console. You can mod them: edit the file, then re-sign it with tools/save-resign.py from the repo. I tested this on the console. Real Xbox saves should also work after re-signing, but I haven’t tested that yet. Back up first.
